caption:
Curing concrete: keep it wet.

IS 456 (clause 13.5.1) asks for at least 7 days of moist curing for OPC and 10 days with fly ash or slag cements, and not less than 10 days in hot, dry weather. Ponding or wet hessian, kept wet the whole time.

Save this for your next pour.
